hook.name: PackERC20Factory
hook.description: A factory hook that creates pack-based ERC20 tokens backed by Chainlink VRF randomness. The beforeInitialize blocks direct pool creation; pools are initialized internally by the factory via enablePackOpening(). After each swap, a 1% fee is taken from the base token as an afterSwapReturnsDelta, and swaps are rejected if the base token is the specified side of the swap.
